note: Absolute total of free email signups captured. AGGREGATE ONLY - no addresses, and no hashes of addresses (a salted SHA-256 of an email is still brute-forceable, so it stays out of the repo too). This file is committed and shipped with the code; Railway wipes its container filesystem on every redeploy, so the container-side counter seeds itself from this number at boot. That is what makes the count survive a redeploy. Starts at 0 because signups captured before the counter existed were never counted and cannot be reconstructed.
